In the member branch, derive the first occurrence, split at the anchor, and distinguish empty versus snoc predecessor prefix. For return_wit_1, substitute the empty-case equalities, derive inserted<>head from separated fields, construct the singleton segment, and close xizi_dll. For return_wit_2, rewrite the snoc nodes and append result, derive inserted<>head, join the prefix/old-last/inserted cells into the final segment, and close xizi_dll. Validate the rewritten bodies with group-check; do not direct-reuse the existing shape-obsolete bodies.
